Same fact, different form (21), the first file's form kept: thermal.max_nozzle_temp stays on the wiki E3D High Flow ObXidian™ Hotend panel at official_doc, the class form for hotends (the store page's "Max. Printing Temp. 300 ℃" agrees, so the merge changes no number); nozzle.diameter 0.4 / 0.6 mm stay on the same panel ("Size: 0.4mm/ 0.6mm"; the store option values agree and keep their official_variant rank); locator wording of compat.statement, nozzle.material, part.color, package.weight/length/width/height and the in_the_box block; the X1C and P1S relations keep the targets of the reviewed compat-targets.json (X1C: family model_x1c, refurbished-x1c; P1S: family model_p1s, p1s) and the wiki evidence, which the store's Compatibility option values X1C / P1 Series agree with; the P1P relation keeps its locator.

Different values (1): nozzle.material stays "ObXidian™ hardened nozzle" (unverified prose). The wiki panel and the store description both say "features the signature ObXidian™ hardened nozzle, and E3DLC™ coating"; the coating is a surface treatment and has its own row (part.surface_treatment), so it is not folded into the nozzle material.

In this file only, each checked against its document and kept: part.surface_treatment (store description, heading "Non-Stick Coating, Reduce the Risk of Nozzle Blobbing" and its paragraph; unverified prose, no number); printing.layer_height 0.1–0.3 mm (0.4 mm) and 0.15–0.45 mm (0.6 mm) from the nozzles wiki Size table, unverified because the table is general guidance for every nozzle of that diameter, as in the other hotend files; the P1S relation to refurbished-p1s (compat-targets.json P1S members: p1s and refurbished-p1s).

In the second extraction only, not taken: not_published part.material. The material this hotend's documents publish is the nozzle's ("ObXidian™ hardened", nozzle.material); a "Materials: not published" row beside it would mislead, and no other hotend file of the class lists it.
